author: harness:codex

patch.value: A truncated list-all answer corrupts fleet throughput and cycle-time metrics

readAllPmItems consumes the items array from pm list-all without verifying the response completeness receipt. A host-side output budget or future regression can therefore make pm ops metrics report a smaller project as a valid result. The same generic reader also converts malformed envelopes and pm failures to null, which is legitimate for a missing/unreadable repository but must not let a successful incomplete list-all read look authoritative. Companion tracking: pm-cli-website-tv05 in unbraind/pm-cli-companion.

A real pm list-all envelope is accepted only when every completeness signal proves a whole-workspace read; Mutating each independent completeness signal makes the metrics reader refuse the row set; The package uses the latest released pm CLI/SDK for development while keeping its consumer compatibility declaration as a lower-bound floor
Every list-all metrics read either proves the envelope is complete before caching rows or returns an explicitly unavailable metric source; no partial row set may be reported as complete.
readPmItemList extracts items and caches them without checking truncated, has_more, next_cursor, completeness, omission receipt, or count-versus-total consistency.

value.text: Implementation uses one receipt gate before metrics cache insertion. The gate requires affirmative completeness and omission receipts, exhausted pagination, count=total=physical rows, and a string id on every row. npm run coverage passed 191 tests (189 passed, 2 explicitly skipped real-data opt-ins) with exact 100/100/100/100 across all 6 production TypeScript files; docstring gate reports 105/105 declarations.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: The regression test captures an unmodified list-all envelope from the package-local pm CLI 2026.8.16, accepts it, then mutates truncated, has_more, next_cursor, completeness, omission, count, total, and row identity one signal at a time. Each mutation makes the repository unavailable; the baseline also records the child argv and proves --output-budget unbounded is present.

message: Record completeness design and exact-gate evidence

author: harness:codex

patch.value: The installed-CLI acceptance reported pm_workspace_available=1 for the real 52-item package tracker. The linked exact gate passed 191 tests with 100/100/100/100 across all six production TypeScript files and 105/105 documented declarations; fourteen independent mutations of the captured real envelope each made availability false.

Every pm workspace reader now requests an unbounded output budget. The all-item metrics reader accepts rows only when truncated=false, has_more=false, next_cursor=null, completeness.status=complete, omission_receipt.has_omissions=false, count and total equal the physical row count, and every row has a string id; otherwise the repository is marked unavailable before any throughput, cycle-time, or backlog metric is computed. The development CLI/SDK is exact-pinned to 2026.8.16, with a >=2026.8.15 consumer floor matching manifest pm_min_version because 2026.8.15 introduced the completeness contract relied on here.
All completeness, dependency, documentation, installed-CLI, and exact coverage acceptance criteria are satisfied.
